summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed an 8-K to report an amendment to its Warrant Agency Agreement with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, allowing the company to unilaterally extend the expiration date of its publicly traded warrants exercisable at $13.00 per share. The board subsequently extended the term from April 24, 2026 to May 1, 2026. This is a routine administrative extension of the warrants' life by one week, not a special situation such as a tender offer, restructuring, or going-private transaction. The warrants continue trading under USGOW on Nasdaq.
